lines.name: Ulster Railway (Belfast–Lisburn)
lines.note: First 7¾ miles to Lisburn opened August 1839 from the Great Victoria Street terminus.

lines.name: Belfast and County Down Railway (Queen's Quay–Holywood)
lines.note: Opened to Holywood 2 August 1848 from Queen's Quay.

lines.name: Belfast and Ballymena Railway (York Road)
lines.note: Opened 11 April 1848 from York Road; the York Road terminus closed in 1992.
